== Published digital-source identity ==
The paired digital image files come from the pinned Holotable repository, with their original bytes preserved. The exact paired title is retained for display; the article qualifier distinguishes source designs, not physical editions. [[:File:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Advanced Rulebook (2023)]], page 152 explicitly identifies the wrong-formula image as digital and all physical copies as correct. The first located repository bounds are July 8, 2018 for the erroneous design and August 26, 2022 for the corrected full design; neither is asserted to be the first public release day. Archive padding is separately qualified, rather than counted as a new card design. No historical executable ID or gameplay defect is asserted. Physical source and reciprocal family navigation: [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 14 November 2026 (UTC).
